en:
[Sorry Mommy...]
I'll go to my English class now...

As long as you understand.
Now let's get going.

As for you! How long are you going to
be a bad influence on Sakito!?

If you have time to lollygag, then you
have time to sell tofu for his college fund!
Y-Yes, absolutely...

Sorry, Kazuma-kun. You shouldn't
have had to see such a pathetic display...

It's fine. That was your wife?
She's pretty intense...

Haha... Yeeaah...
But she's good in her own way.

She'll do whatever it takes to make
sure Sakito grows up good and strong.
We can't let him take after me, after all...
I can't say I agree with that...

Well, anyway, I need to get back to work.
Kazuma-kun, it was great seeing you again.

If you're still in the area later,
stop by again so we can catch up.

Sure thing.
Good luck with the tofu, Pocket Circuit Fighter.

Hey, Kazuma-kun.
How about some tofu?

Thanks a lot.
Come back again.
Come back again.
Oh. Kazuma-san.
Hm? You're Pocket Circuit Fighter's son.

Sakito.
[My name is Sakito.]

Sorry, that's right.
What are you doing here?

There's still some time before my English
class starts, so I was just spacing out.

Is that so?
By the way, how old are you, Sakito?
[Eight years old!]

[Eight...] That means "eight" right?
You speak English really well for your age.

It's nothing special, really.
I don't really care about learning English...
You don't?

Yeah. I have to go to English class every day.
I'm sick of it.

Mr. Kazuma-san,
what were you like at my age?
Hmm. Well, I certainly didn't study as much as you.

Oh really?
...That'd be nice.

Yeah. I used to hang out with your dad a lot.
Although I was already a grown man by then.
Oh yeah, you're friends with Daddy, right?
Yeah, sure am.

We raced Pocket Circuit cars together back then.
Everyone called him Pocket Circuit Fighter!

Pocket Circuit... Fighter?
What did Daddy do back then?

Hm? Your dad never told
you about Pocket Circuit?

Well... I'm not supposed to talk
to Daddy unless I have to...

You're not allowed?
Why's that?

Mommy says if I talk to Daddy,
he'll be "a bad inflooenz."
He must mean the Fighter's wife...

She was pretty rough on Fighter
when I saw them earlier...

Do your mom and dad
not get along well?

I don't know. Daddy says it wasn't
like this back in Tokyo...

He says when they came back here,
Mommy turned to the dark side.

But she doesn't like it when I talk to
Daddy, especially about his past.

I get it now... And you just want to be
closer to your dad, is that right?

Yeah... I want to ask Daddy
about a lot of stuff...

We share a house and stuff...
But I don't even know my daddy.
Is that even a real family?
I understand, I get that.

If he won't tell you though,
then I'll tell you about your dad!
Huh? Really? You will?

Yeah. Pocket Circuit bound us together.
Ask me anything you want.
Yay! [Thank you,] Mr. Kazuma-san!
But, what exactly <font_kind=yakuza_italic>is</font_kind> Pocket Circuit?
Right, I should explain that first.

Pocket Circuit is... Well, you have a little car,
and then there are all these parts...

You know what, it might be easier to just
show you rather than trying to explain it.

But... Where could I find a Pocket Circuit
car in this day and age?

Oh, I know! Sakito, have you ever seen
any small toy cars at your house?
Toy cars? Hmm, I don't think so...

Oh! I think I saw a small box with
a picture of a car on it in the closet.

That's probably a Pocket Circuit kit!
Sakito, could you bring it to me?

Yeah, no problem! I'll be right back!
Let's meet up here in a little bit, okay!?
Yeah. Just make sure your mom's not watching.
Oh, Mr. Kazuma-san!

Hey, Sakito.
Did you find it?

Is this it?
Is this a Pocket Circuit?
Yep, that's a Pocket Circuit machine!
So this is Pocket Circuit...

Yeah. Your dad and I were really into these
when we were young. This takes me back...
Daddy played with this?

Kazuma-san. Will this car still work?
I wanna try playing Pocket Circuit!

Maybe it would...!
Sure! Wanna put it together?
There, done.

Wow! That's so cool!
I wanna drive it!
Sakito! What are you doing here!?
Oh, Daddy!

Hey, Fighter.
You came at a great time!

Kazuma-kun? What's going on?
D-Don't tell me that's...

Look, look!
I built it with Mr. Kazuma-san!

Isn't it cool!?
Now we can play Pocket Circuit...!
Stop this tomfoolery! At once!

It's almost time for your English class!
Your mother will blow a fuse if you skip class!
And how dare you rifle through my closet!

If you have time to play with toys,
you have time to study your English!

Hey, Fighter...
This is on me.
D-Daddy, you suck!
Hey, Sakito!

Fighter, I'm the one who told Sakito
to get a Pocket Circuit kit from your house.
I apologize for that.

But... You didn't have to lay
into him like that, either.

I hear you, but if he skips English class,
he'll get an earful from his mother.

This is best for Sakito. I like you Kazuma-kun, but you
should stay away if you're going to jeopardize his future.
Fighter... You've changed.

Changed... Maybe I have.
But I don't exactly have a choice.

If Sakito is going to lead a good life
after being born to a loser like me...

...He has to work twice as
hard as everyone else.

So... Me and Sakito need to make
my wife's plan our first priority.

Your son just wants to know more
about you, his father.

He asked me about you when you were younger.
Did you know he doesn't feel he can talk to you?

He just wants to know who you are...
And you shouldn't keep that from him.

B-But... I might be a bad influence on him,
and I'd get in the way of his studies...

Fighter. Back in the day, you made so many
kids happy through Pocket Circuit.

Yes, you were irresponsible, insecure, and clumsy...
But the kids all trusted you.

That's because, back then,
you could see things from their point of view.

If you could do it back then, you should
have no problem making your only son smile.
Am I wrong, Pocket Circuit Fighter?
I'm just a different person now.

Back then, I loved being the fighter,
but it was my job to play that role...

So the best I can do for him now is
watch over him from a distance.

We're done here.
You disappoint me.

I'm worried about Sakito.
I'm gonna go look for him.

He'll probably go where
he can see the ocean.

Whenever he's down, he goes to
look at the ocean and mope.

Kazuma-kun. I'm really sorry
that it's you making this right...
Sakito's somewhere near the ocean, right?

Yeah. Whenever he's down,
he goes to look at the ocean and mope.

Kazuma-kun. I'm really sorry.
Please make things right...
Ow, that stings!
Li'l brat!
Hm? Isn't that Sakito?

Whaddaya think yer doin', running
yer toys into people's feet? Huh!?

I-I'm sorry...
I lost control of it for a sec...

If apologies fixed everythin',
we wouldn't have the cops!

Yer gonna have t'show
us where y'live, kid!

I'd say yer parents owe some
cash to cover a doctor's visit!

C-Come on...
It was just a little bump...

The fuck y'say, brat!?
Get your parents, now! Or else...
S-Stop it!

That car is part of my daddy's past!
Please! Please just stop!
I just want my daddy to be happy again!

Huh? T'hell you sayin?
Y'got some nerve, kid!
These punks...!
Kazuma-kun. Leave this to me.
Hey! Back away from that kid!
The... hell?
Who are you!?
I am... Pocket Circuit Fighter!

P-Pocket Circuit Fighter?
The fuck...?
D-Daddy!

Hm? So you're this brat's daddy!
Y'saved us the trouble of findin' ya!

No... I have no right to
call myself his father.

It's only because I pushed him
away that he's in danger now...
I'm so pathetic...

What're ya mumblin' about!? Just give
us the cash before we beat it outta ya!

I don't have a single yen for
villains who make children cry!

Sakito... I lost my confidence.
That's why I kept running from you.

I couldn't bear the thought...
that you might end up like me.
But... I won't run anymore!

Your dad might be a weak, awkward loser,
but he's gonna give it his all!
So... Never forget this moment, Sakito!

Daddy... No, Father!
You can beat these guys!
Apparently you both wanna die?

Aniki! Looks like our back-up
got here just in time.

Uh, whoa whoa whoa...
I-Isn't five-on-one kinda unfair...
Gonna piss your pants?

If you've got your back-up,
it's only fair if I back up Fighter, right?
K-Kazuma-kun!
Eh? What's your deal?

I'm a friend of Fighter's. And anyone who
picks on kids... is on my shit list.

So you wanna share a grave or somethin'?
Couple'a dumbfucks here, huh?

Fine, y'assholes! Y'can die together,
being that you're best buds and all!
What's up with this guy!?

A-Aniki! Let's beat it!
They're gonna murder us!
Kazuma-kun... Thank you!

I really am a pathetic father.
I'm all bark and no bite...

If you hadn't showed up, I'd have gotten
too beat up to even protect Sakito...
Fighter... I wouldn't say you're pathetic.
Father! Are you okay?

Yeah, I'm fine.
Are you okay, Sakito?

Yeah! Mr. Kazuma-san and
Pocket Circuit Fighter protected me!
You're so cool as Pocket Circuit Fighter!

I wanna know who Pocket Circuit Fighter really is...
Who my father is!

Sakito! There you are! 
What exactly is going on here!?
Oh, Mommy...

And why are you dressed in
that stupid old get-up!?

You endangered Sakito with
your stupid antics, didn't you!?

That's wrong, Mommy.
Pocket Circuit Fighter protec<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
I've heard enough excuses!

We don't have time to discuss this!
You're already late for English class!

What in the world were you all thinking!?
Are you trying to make my life miserable!?

Mommy... I...
I don't want to go to English class today!

Nonsense! What would you propose is a
better use of time than learning English!?
I wanna play with my father...

Absolutely not! Sakito, don't you care about
your future? And it's "daddy", not "father!"
Look at your daddy!

He had no choice but to inherit a tofu shop
because he goofed off until he was 50!

He's a sad, meek, tofu-hawking loser
who can't even stand up to his own wife!
Is that how you want to end up!?

I don't even know whether or
not I want to be like Daddy.

I don't know the first thing about him.
How could I know if I want to be like him?

That's why I want to get to know him.
I wanna be friends with my Daddy.

And once I know him...
Then I can figure out the future!

Sakito! Hold on!
Would you say something to your son!?

Sakito... I'm sorry you just had to say all that.
I've really failed you as a father all this time.
But, I'm gonna be a real dad now.

I want to raise you with confidence,
like a real father should.

Misaki. Call the English school and tell them
he'll be spending the day with his father.

Now just one minute!
I refuse to allow such<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
BE QUIET!

Sure, I may have been forced into the family
business, and yeah, I suck at making tofu!
And, I'm totally whipped by my wife!

But! I am his father!
He wants to spend time with me!

If you want me to ignore my son's feelings,
then... You may as well kill me now!

Please, Misaki.
Let me be a father to our son.
Fine. You have my permission.

Huh? I-It's really okay?
Even skipping English...?

Yes. But when you come home, you're
catching up on your lessons. Understood?

Y-Yeah! I will!
I promise!

I need to relax, don't I? I've just been so
stressed about Sakito's future lately...
And...?

I don't know what just got into you,
but that was the man I fell in love with.
Well, I'll go call the school.
Mom... Thank you!
Sakito. Your dad was pretty cool, huh?

Yeah! Super cool!
I didn't know he could yell so loud!
You're embarrassing me...

Sakito, I'm sorry I wasn't paying
attention to your feelings!

No, it's okay!
You were there for me when it counted!

Sakito... All right!
It's time for a Pocket Circuit battle!

Yeah! I wanna try Pocket Circuit!
You were really fast, right, Dad?

Is there any doubt!?
I'm the one and only... Pocket Circuit Fighter!

Okay! Let's have a race to see who
can get the cars from my closet first!
Ready, go!
Hey, Kazuma-kun!

Hey. How've things with your son
been since I saw you last?

They're going well, thanks to you.
He's been getting really into Pocket Circuit.

That's great. Guess the need
for speed runs in the family.

Oh, by the way. I heard you're putting
a crew together. Is the rumor true?
Hm? Yeah, I am.

If you've got room for one more...
How about I join you?

Huh? You? I appreciate it, but this
group is pretty dangerous actually...

I was just thinking back to that fight,
and as a father, I want to be stronger.
